prior_same_output_replay.limitation: Single before/after observation, not a randomized repeated A/B.

grammar_scope: Lazy tool JSON and supported structural schemas; no full strict JSON Schema claim.

quality_rubric.purpose: Apply the same observable requirements to each independently generated game; evaluate outputs, not engine correctness.

statuses.pass: Direct browser observation or a narrowly stated source check demonstrates the stated criterion.
statuses.partial: Some required behavior works; specific missing behavior is recorded.
statuses.fail: A reproducible failure or clearly absent implementation violates the criterion.
statuses.unverified: Insufficient evidence; never counts as a pass.

criteria.requirement: Separate index.html, style.css, game.js and README; referenced files exist; JavaScript syntax valid.
Loads and runs without external resources or uncaught JavaScript errors in tested paths.
Initial title, intelligible instructions, explicit target, and start button.
Start begins a visible playable round and removes obstructing menus.
Score, remaining time, and shields visible and updated while playing.
WASD and arrow keys move the ship fluently; speed and acceleration usable.
Ship remains entirely within playfield, including on resize.
Moving asteroids have varied sizes; simulation uses elapsed time with bounded delta.
Collecting reachable cells increases score and cells appear at changing positions.
A collision costs one shield and grants brief invulnerability with visible feedback.
Three separated damaging collisions end the round with clear result.
Difficulty grows over time without obviously unfair initial placement.
Reaching the target ends the round with a clear successful result.
Time expiration ends the round with a clear result.
Visible controls pause and resume the game without advancing simulation while paused.
Escape and P pause/resume; resuming continues the simulation.
Window focus loss pauses the game and cannot silently continue play.
Arrow controls do not scroll the page during play.
Restart after ending resets score, shields, time, ship, objects, pause state, and animation loop consistently.
At narrow viewport the layout fits and visible touch direction controls function.
Buttons keyboard reachable with visible focus state.
Important state changes have visible textual indication; HUD and menus legible.
Decorative animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Personal record persists, never decreases, and unavailable storage does not crash.
Start, pause/resume, and restart do not create concurrent animation loops.
Recognizable spacecraft, stars, cells, and asteroids; coherent legible presentation and event feedback.

limits: A small fixed set of browser scenarios cannot establish absence of all bugs or prove long-run playability.
Controlled-state tests may arrange collisions or set time/score only in a fresh in-memory page; generated source files remain unchanged.
Random collision behavior and game feel are not rigorously established by source inspection or pixel differences alone.
Report source-level findings separately from actual browser observations and do not call untested criteria passed.
No composite quality score unless its rule and evidential limitations are stated.
